title: The gym web page chat takes AI credits even while charging for AI answers is switched off
what: MettleUp has one master switch that holds back all charging for AI answers: while it is off, nothing should be taken from any gym and the admin app hides the credit counts. The members' help box and the owner's Assistant obey it. The AI chat on a gym's web page does not: it takes the gym's credits on the gym server every time, whatever that switch says. Today both are set so it does not show (charging on, page chat off), but turning charging off while the page chat is on would quietly spend gyms' credits with no counts shown to the owner.
expected: With charging switched off, a web page chat answer costs the gym nothing, the same as every other AI answer.
how_often: only if charging is switched off while page chat is on
fix_line: Have the web page chat check the charging switch first and tell the gym server not to take a credit while it is off.

title: Speaking to the AI Assistant still works when its AI is paused or resting for the month
what: When MettleUp pauses a gym's AI answers, or a trial gym's monthly AI money runs out, typed requests to the Assistant are refused. A spoken request is still sent to the speech company and turned into text first, using paid speech time, and only then is the owner told the Assistant is paused or resting. The owner talks, sees the text, and then gets a no.
expected: A spoken request is refused up front with the same paused or resting message as a typed one, before any speech time is spent.
how_often: every spoken request while paused or resting
fix_line: Run the same pause and monthly-limit checks before turning a spoken request into text.
